metadata.title: SPARC EC2 S3 Storage Component Definition

components.title: AWS S3 Bucket (ActiveStorage)
components.description: Encrypted S3 bucket for SPARC ActiveStorage file uploads with versioning, public access block, and CORS configuration. Deployed via Terraform (AWS/EC2/modules/s3/). <!-- UPDATE: Insert bucket name, ARN, and region for your deployment. -->

control-implementations.description: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 control implementations for S3

implemented-requirements.description: Protection of Information at Rest: S3 bucket uses AWS KMS server-side encryption (SSE-KMS) with bucket key enabled for all stored objects. Every uploaded file is automatically encrypted before being written to disk. Encryption is enforced — unencrypted uploads are rejected. Reference: DISA SRG-APP-000231, CIS AWS 2.1.1.

Access Enforcement: The S3 bucket blocks all public access via aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block (block_public_acls, block_public_policy, ignore_public_acls, restrict_public_buckets all set to true). Only the EC2 instance role has IAM permissions to read/write objects (s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject, s3:DeleteObject, s3:ListBucket). No bucket policy allows external access. Reference: DISA SRG-APP-000033, CIS AWS 2.1.5.

System Backup: S3 versioning is enabled, retaining all previous versions of uploaded files. This provides point-in-time recovery for uploaded artifacts and protects against accidental deletion or overwrites. Combined with S3's 99.999999999% durability, this ensures data protection for SPARC uploads. Reference: DISA SRG-APP-000065, CIS AWS 2.1.3.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Terraform resource: aws_s3_bucket_versioning.uploads with status = Enabled.

implemented-requirements.description: Event Logging: S3 access logging can be enabled to record all requests made to the bucket. CloudTrail data events can be configured to log S3 object-level API calls (GetObject, PutObject, DeleteObject) for audit purposes. Reference: DISA SRG-APP-000089, CIS AWS 2.1.4.
implemented-requirements.remarks: S3 access logging and CloudTrail data events are not provisioned by this module. Enable for production compliance requirements.

implemented-requirements.description: Media Sanitization: KMS-encrypted S3 objects are cryptographically erased when deleted — data cannot be recovered without the KMS key. S3 versioning provides soft-delete capability via delete markers, with permanent deletion available via lifecycle policies or explicit version deletion. Reference: DISA SRG-APP-000516.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Consider adding S3 lifecycle rules to permanently expire old versions after a defined retention period.
